title: Almost-linear-time exact matching and prescribed-degree factors in general graphs

result.label: Almost-linear-time exact matching and prescribed-degree factors in general graphs
result.statement: Gives a randomized algorithm finding an exact maximum-cardinality matching in any simple undirected graph in (n+m)^ 1+o(1) word time, with success probability at least 2/3. The time bound holds on every computation path. The same guarantees apply to finding a spanning subgraph with prescribed admissible vertex degrees, or deciding that none exists.
